title: [Master]-Aged account receivable EXCEL and Aged account payable EXCEL ignores "Period Count" specified by user.
summary: Aged Accounts Receivable and Payable Excel reports now correctly respect the Period Count parameter specified by users, fixing a bug where this setting was being ignored.
key_points: Period Count parameter was ignored in both aged reports
Applied fix to Aged Accounts Receivable Excel (report 4402) and Aged Accounts Payable Excel (report 4403)
Added test coverage for the Period Count functionality
Fix ensures user-specified period counts are properly applied when generating Excel reports
